entries.description: 通过画皮覆盖住身体， 可以防住１次攻击。

entries.name: 怒火冲天
entries.description: 因对手的攻击 ＨＰ变为一半时， 特攻会提高。

entries.name: 魂心
entries.description: 宝可梦每次变为濒死状态时， 特攻会提高。

entries.name: 青草制造者
entries.description: 出场时布下青草场地，后续版本接入场地系统。

entries.name: 自由者
entries.description: 出招时变为该招式属性。

entries.name: 镜甲
entries.description: 只反弹自己受到的 能力降低效果。

entries.name: 逃跑
entries.description: 一定能从野生宝可梦 那儿逃走。

entries.name: 蹲守
entries.description: 可以对替换出场的对手 以２倍的伤害进行攻击。

entries.name: 熟成
entries.description: 使树果成熟， 效果变为２倍。

entries.name: 活力
entries.description: 攻击提升 50%，命中率下降。

entries.name: 吐沙
entries.description: 受到攻击时， 会刮起沙暴。

entries.name: 朋克摇滚
entries.description: 声音招式威力提升 30%。

entries.name: 精神制造者
entries.description: 出场时， 会布下精神场地。

entries.name: 饱了又饿
entries.description: 每回合结束时会在 满腹花纹与空腹花纹之间 交替改变样子。

entries.name: 毛茸茸
entries.description: 会将对手所给予的接触类招式的伤害减半， 但火属性招式的伤害会变为２倍。

entries.name: 跟风
entries.description: When an opposing Pokemon has a stat stage raised, this Pokemon copies the effect.

entries.name: 全能变身
entries.description: If this Pokemon is a Palafin in Zero Form, switching out has it change to Hero Form.

entries.name: 掉出种子
entries.description: When this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the effect of Grassy Terrain begins.

entries.name: 辣椒喷发
entries.description: If this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the attacker becomes burned.

entries.name: 电力转换
entries.description: This Pokemon gains the Charge effect when it takes a hit from an attack.

entries.name: 食土
entries.description: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Ground moves; Ground immunity.

entries.name: 热交换
entries.description: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 when damaged by Fire moves; can't be burned.

entries.name: 洁净之盐
entries.description: Ghost damage to this Pokemon dealt with a halved offensive stat; can't be statused.

entries.name: 毒满地
entries.description: If this Pokemon is hit by a physical attack, Toxic Spikes are set on the opposing side.

entries.name: 看门犬
entries.description: Immune to Intimidate. Intimidated: +1 Attack. Cannot be forced to switch out.

entries.name: 黄金之躯
entries.description: 免疫变化招式。

entries.name: 大将
entries.description: This Pokemon's moves have 10% more power for each fainted ally, up to 5 allies.

entries.name: 款待
entries.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon restores 1/4 of its ally's maximum HP, rounded down.

entries.name: 耐热
entries.description: 耐热的体质会 让火属性的招式威力减半。

entries.name: 甘露之蜜
entries.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the evasiveness of opponents 1 stage. Once per battle.
